meta.issuingAuthority: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka

fields.label: Title
fields.hint: Select your title (e.g. MR, MRS, MISS, MS).

fields.label: Surname / Family Name
fields.hint: Enter your family name exactly as shown in your passport.
fields.warning: Must match passport exactly. Leave blank if you do not have a surname.

fields.label: Other / Given Names
fields.hint: Enter your given names exactly as shown in your passport.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Enter your date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format matching your passport.

fields.label: Re-enter Date of Birth
fields.hint: Re-enter your date of birth for verification.

fields.label: Gender
fields.hint: Select your gender.

fields.label: Nationality
fields.hint: Select your citizenship as shown in your passport.

fields.label: Country or Region of Birth
fields.hint: Select your country of birth.

fields.label: Occupation
fields.hint: Enter your current profession or job title.

fields.label: Passport Number
fields.hint: Enter your passport number exactly as shown on the bio page.

fields.label: Re-enter Passport Number
fields.hint: Re-enter passport number to confirm.

fields.label: Passport Issued Date
fields.hint: Enter the date your passport was issued.

fields.label: Passport Expiry Date
fields.hint: Enter the expiration date of your passport.
fields.warning: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months from arrival.

fields.label: Where you have been during last 14 days before this travel?
fields.hint: Select the country/region you departed from or spent time in before traveling.

fields.label: Intended Arrival Date
fields.hint: Select your planned date of entry into Sri Lanka.

fields.label: Purpose of Visit
fields.hint: Select the primary reason for your business visit.

fields.label: Purpose Description
fields.hint: Provide a brief description of the purpose of your business visit (max 100 characters).
fields.example: Attending annual board meeting at Colombo office.

fields.label: Port of Departure
fields.hint: Enter the city/airport from which you will depart.

fields.label: Airline / Vessel
fields.hint: Enter the name of the airline or cruise line.

fields.label: Flight / Vessel Number
fields.hint: Enter your flight number.

sections.label: Contact Details of the Applicant's Company

fields.label: Company Name
fields.hint: Enter the name of your employing company in your home country.

fields.label: Address Line 1
fields.hint: Enter company house/flat number, building name, and street.

fields.label: Address Line 2
fields.hint: Enter company street extension or area name.

fields.label: City
fields.hint: Enter company's city.

fields.label: State
fields.hint: Enter company's state/province.

fields.label: Zip / Postal Code
fields.hint: Enter company's postal code.

fields.label: Country or Region
fields.hint: Select company's country.

fields.label: Telephone Number
fields.hint: Enter company's telephone number.

fields.label: Mobile Number
fields.hint: Enter your mobile number at the company.

fields.label: Fax Number
fields.hint: Enter company's fax number if any.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.hint: Enter company email address.

fields.label: Re-enter Email Address
fields.hint: Re-enter company email address to confirm.

sections.label: Contact Details of the Sri Lankan Company

fields.label: Company Name
fields.hint: Enter the name of the host company in Sri Lanka.

fields.label: Address Line 1
fields.hint: Enter host company address line 1.

fields.label: Address Line 2
fields.hint: Enter host company address line 2.

fields.label: City
fields.hint: Enter host company city.

fields.label: State
fields.hint: Enter host company state/province.

fields.label: Zip / Postal Code
fields.hint: Enter host company zip/postal code.

fields.label: Telephone Number
fields.hint: Enter host company telephone number.

fields.label: Mobile Number
fields.hint: Enter host company mobile number if any.

fields.label: Fax Number
fields.hint: Enter host company fax number if any.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.hint: Enter host company email address.

fields.label: 1. Do you have a valid residence visa to Sri Lanka?
fields.hint: Select Yes or No.

fields.label: 2. Do you have a multiple entry visa to Sri Lanka?
fields.hint: Select Yes or No.

fields.label: 3. Are you currently in Sri Lanka with a valid ETA or obtained an extension of visa?
fields.hint: Select Yes or No.

fields.label: I would like to confirm the above information is correct.
fields.hint: Check this box to confirm all details are true.
